description: TI SN74LVC1T45 (DBV, SOT-23-6) B-port output driving 5 V logic, from TI's IBIS model converted to SPICE by KiCad KIBIS (RECTDRIVER).

corner_note: KIBIS corner strings must be upper case (KIBIS_PARAMETER::SetCornerFromString: anything but MIN/MAX silently means TYP; the rail read back from VPWR is checked against rail_v). KIBIS pairs the I-V/V-t column with [Voltage range]: LVC1T45_IO_B_50 typ/min/max = 5.0/4.5/5.5 V (slow-weak at 4.5 V, fast-strong at 5.5 V). Package: the SN74LVC1T45_DBV [Pin] row of pin 4 gives R/L/C 19 mOhm / 1.62 nH / 0.264 pF, which KIBIS applies at every corner ([Pin] overrides [Package]), so rpin/lpin/cpin stay TYP (pnr.si.models rejects any other value as a silent no-op). C_comp: KIBIS always writes the typ column (6.40 pF); pnr.si.models substitutes the corner's column (post-processing ccomp-v1). The IBIS C_comp min/max columns are the capacitance extremes, not I-V corners; they are paired pessimistically: the slow-weak corner gets the largest die capacitance (MAX 7.92 pF, slowest edge for the rise/fall gates) and the fast-strong corner the smallest (MIN 5.43 pF, fastest edge, most overshoot).

kibis.note: ton/toff must exceed the IBIS waveform tables (25 ns for IO_B_50).
